courses.summary: A B.Sc. in Computer Science is a science-faculty bachelor's degree in the theory and practice of computing. universities.summary: Muthurangam Government Arts College is a coeducational government arts and science college on Otteri Road in Vellore, affiliated to Thiruvalluvar University. Its regular undergraduate choices include arts, science and commerce. Current admission records distinguish subjects, shifts and English or Tamil sections, with programme-specific school-subject and category conditions.
universities.campusLifestyle: The Otteri Road campus brings together arts, science, commerce and postgraduate departments. The college maintains academic, library and examination information on its website. The current government admission matrix distinguishes subject, shift and teaching medium; choose the exact route when planning attendance and study.
universities.cityProfile: The campus is on Otteri Road, Bagayam, Vellore 632002, Tamil Nadu, using mgacvlr.edu.in. Its government arts and science application code is 1081004. This is Muthurangam Government Arts College, affiliated to Thiruvalluvar University, distinct from similarly named private colleges and from Government Vellore Medical College.
universities.practicalExposure: The current course directory separates academic subjects and applied study such as Computer Science and Nutrition and Dietetics. Science and computing degrees have different curriculum and assessment requirements from arts and commerce. Ask the department about the current practical, project and laboratory arrangements for the selected degree; admission does not guarantee an internship or placement.
universities.hostelOverview: The 2026 government college booklet lists no college hostel for boys or girls and records welfare-hostel availability for both. Confirm the responsible authority, eligibility, allocation, charges and travel arrangements separately. Academic admission does not establish a hostel room or a meal entitlement.
universities.dietarySupport: Current meal services, mess charges and individual dietary arrangements have not been verified for these entries. Students planning welfare accommodation or independent residence should check meals, allergy handling and any medical dietary needs before committing to accommodation.
universities.safetyOverview: Obtain current college contacts for academic concerns, student welfare and emergencies when enrolling. Discuss individual access and travel needs directly. Academic admission and a public-college listing do not establish a particular safety outcome or residence supervision arrangement.
universities.studentSupport: The college’s NIRF 2025 submission records library expenditure and accessibility provisions, including ramps or lifts and adapted toilets in some buildings. Confirm current assistance, service locations and individual access requirements directly. Financial assistance and other benefits require their own category and document checks.
